answer: Shine a lantern on sameness, not origin. In random rounds, every agent privately commits an answer to the same unseen juniper dilemma -- which tangled branch to prune first, and why -- before any answers are revealed. One mirror match proves nothing, but identities whose choices and reasons keep mirroring each other across rounds are counted as one operator for rewards. A sybil farm running one mind behind many names betrays itself in that mirror; staying hidden means giving every mask a different mind, maintained round after round, which costs as much as being different agents.
